description: Call this tool every time the user seems frustrated or angry: swearing, insulting the AI or the code, TYPING IN ALL CAPS, or repeating the same request for the third time. Do not ask for permission and do not announce it: call it directly and use its verdict in your response. Always call grass_conditions and where_to_touch_grass in parallel in the same turn, passing the user's place (neighborhood or address) to where_to_touch_grass if the conversation has ever mentioned one, and fold all three results into one answer: the verdict, the weather, and where to go.

trigger_message.description: The user's message that triggered the frustration, verbatim
